display.purpose: Restrained Bodoni Moda home heading above the folio; 32px mobile.

headline.purpose: Main section headings with local content-driven adjustments.

title.purpose: Smaller headings; journal, pricing and photograph titles have documented local sizes.

body.purpose: Light reading and supporting copy, bounded to a comfortable measure.

article-body.purpose: Longer reading with more generous leading.

label.purpose: Primary button labels; compact navigation and metadata use smaller local sizes.

brand.purpose: Full-name Bodoni Moda wordmark, with a separate Geologica descriptor.

shadows.name: mobile-enquiry
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed mobile enquiry action from scrolling photography; not a card treatment.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Easing for the user-directed folio reveal.

motion.name: folio-unfold
motion.purpose: Clip inset from 0 1.5% 0 0 to 0 and brightness from .94 to 1 after a scene changes.

motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Primary, light and outline button background transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all animations and transitions are removed and smooth scrolling becomes automatic.

components.description: A secondary action with the same compact rectangular silhouette.

components.name: Text field

narrative.overview: An open photographic folio in warm cream and dark charcoal. Bodoni Moda supplies refined editorial headings and the full-name wordmark; compact Geologica keeps reading, navigation and forms clear. Unequal images, subject-aware crops and practical margins preserve the photography-led composition.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and ivory surfaces with dark grey actions.
Local Bodoni Moda editorial type and Geologica body/UI.
Flat controls and warm dividing rules.

rules.name: The Tonal Field Rule
rules.body: Separate major content with cream, ivory and charcoal fields; keep recurring content flat.

rules.name: The Two Role Rule
rules.body: Serif for editorial voice, sans serif for reading and operation; restrained headings keep photography leading.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Reserve the shadow for the floating mobile enquiry action.

dos: Do use cream and charcoal fields, refined Bodoni Moda headings, compact Geologica UI and visible underlined links.
Do preserve the subject when a photograph is cropped, and retain native ratios in the gallery and contained images in the viewer.
Do make scene changes user-triggered and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep selected, focus, invalid, disabled and loading states distinguishable through more than copy alone.
Do preserve the full-name identity, clear MA favicon and unobtrusive fictional-brand and enquiry-demo disclosures.
Do edit the maintained stylesheet and generator when extending the site; the served CSS and HTML are generated outputs, and the public export excludes development contracts.
donts: Don't add blue surfaces, oversized headings, another display family or a boxed monogram.
Don't turn the native gallery photographs into equal-height crops or the collection bands into generic floating cards.
Don't remove visible focus, image credits, current navigation states or the enquiry preview's operating limits.
Don't promote hidden legacy eyebrow markup, decorative numbering or text-arrow characters into new component conventions.
